items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: all the great song players were Benny Goodman, Charlie Margus, Vanny Kline and Bob Bitty Butterfield.

ctx.x: And it hadn‟t gotten to let any black guys in until the later half of the 40;s and the 50‟s because all the great song players were Benny Goodman, Charlie Margus, Vanny Kline and Bob Bitty Butterfield. Bitty Butterfield was seen as a more modern guy, helping out to do things. I remember Billy Hacket also, he was with the guys that kind of helped get some guys into the studios.
Was Billy Taylor the bass player, the first black musician on CBS, do you know?
